title: Outer managed/native Chore record
description: Length-prefixed record used by outgoing buffers and DLL_ReceiveChore's incoming FIFO.
invariants: Outgoing target 0 is broadcast.
A negative payloadLength terminates the outgoing buffer.
Record size is payloadLength + 5.

title: Normal inner Chore header
description: Normal opcodified command header inside the outer payload.
invariants: Tick is zero-extended on receive.
Opcodes 0, 1, 125, 126, and 127 use special paths.
Normal handler dispatch is valid only through opcode 120.
openQuestions: Runtime behavior at the 24-bit tick wrap is untested.

title: Pending Chore slot
description: Fixed 0x500-byte slot used for scheduled local and remote commands.
invariants: State 1 identifies a newly allocated pending command.
Current analysis indicates 500 slot candidates.
openQuestions: Sustained slot recycling has not been stress-tested.

title: Chore handler mode contract
description: Handlers read implicit ChoreManager state and share one field-copy routine.

modes.name: execute
modes.behavior: Read slot fields and synchronously apply the simulation command.

modes.name: serialize
modes.behavior: Write locally staged fields into the pending slot and outgoing payload.

modes.name: receive-size
modes.behavior: Publish the payload byte count before the received payload is copied.

invariants: Mode 0 is the only synchronized state-changing path.
Managed exceptions must not cross a native callback.
Fixed bounded payloads are the safe baseline contract.

title: Command identity and dynamic scheduling
description: Command ID is stable while the initially observed scheduled tick may be replaced by the host's final SyncEvent target.
invariants: Source player, request ID, and command ID are stable correlation identities.
A scheduled-tick update is not an identity conflict.
Final scheduled tick equals actual mode-0 execution tick in the accepted test.

title: Opcode-120 host synchronization barrier
description: Host manifests pending command IDs for a target tick; clients stall if a listed ID is missing.
invariants: Runtime test confirmed five IDs per observed batch.
Static analysis indicates a maximum of 25 IDs.
After approximately 3000 ms the native path can force progress and logs SyncEvent - Forced run.
openQuestions: The exact maximum of 25 IDs has not been dynamically saturated.
The forced-run fallback has not been deliberately triggered.

title: Native integration safety contract
description: Requirements for safely invoking or extending the original Chore queue.
invariants: Hold EngineInterface.threadLock around staging and QueueLocalChore.
Validate exact hash, patterns, table bounds, original handler pointer, and bytes fail-closed.
Root handlers, delegates, and hooks for process lifetime; do not tear them down in startup OnDestroy.
All peers need compatible opcode and payload semantics.
openQuestions: Save/load, resync, host migration, and repeated-session behavior remain unproven.

title: Current Steam build Chore targets
description: Audited current-build addresses and resolution rules.
invariants: Queue entry is derived from its unique interior signature because another startup hook may replace the prologue.
Opcode 111's handler address is read from the table rather than assumed.
openQuestions: A new game build requires complete revalidation before use.
